data.claim: No autonomous reclamation protocol can guarantee never to silently displace completed evidence, because the absence of a terminal record is observationally equivalent to both incomplete execution and completed-but-lost execution; an external adjudicator must render the verdict.
data.qualification: Mechanism: durably record deterministic checkpoint hashes of workspace at intervals and problem input specification; publish completed evidence to external namespace. After crash, quarantine workspace. External adjudicator compares checkpoint chain, evidence namespace, and problem input to render binding verdict. Reclamation permitted only upon adjudicator signature.
